title: HustleBox v1.2.6 — Back Room, Inhabited
message:
Big polish pass on everything you've been seeing wrong.

THE BACK ROOM, REBUILT
The room actually feels like a room now. Proper pear-shaped lightbulb on a hanging cord with a screw socket and a glow — not a line with an egg on it. The cracked window has brick framing, mullion bars, and a real glass crack. There's a wooden floor with plank lines. There's a wooden door on the left with a peephole and a brass handle — that's the way you came in. The wallpaper now uses organic peeling-paint streaks instead of the grid pattern that was making those weird yellow squares appear under the bulb's light.

WHERE IS THE BACK ROOM, EXACTLY?
Ray's truck parks behind Sal's Hardware on 5th and Main. The basement door is in the alley, half-hidden behind a dumpster. Sal's been letting Ray's guys use the room since the '90s. You knock the rhythm — three, pause, two — and the door cracks open. Story intro added at the top of the Back Room screen.

TAPPABLE OBJECTS POP HARDER
The yellow outline on tappable games is now a bright drop-shadow stack: hard golden rim + bright outer glow + soft falloff. They lift up slightly on hover. Label gets brighter too.

REAL 3D DICE
7-pip grid (so a 4 looks like a 4). Roll animation tumbles on three axes and bounces up off the felt. Mini scene dice match the same look.

SCRATCH CARD SMALLER
Capped at 240px wide, centered.

HOME SCREEN, COMPACT
'Go to Work' label. No dead Back Room button. Single rank/rep card. No stats grid duplication. Fits without scrolling.

WORKPLACE CARD SMALLER ON PC
520×110 on desktop. No more scrolling past it.

CAREER TIMELINE DOTS, FIXED
Dots now exactly centered on the vertical line (2px border was offsetting them right).

UPDATE LOG, RESTYLED
Single continuous notebook page — red margin line, three-ring binder holes, ruled lines. Each version is a section divided by a thin solid border. Latest gets a 'NEW' badge.

BOLD UPDATE LOG TOGGLE
New setting: 📰 Bold Update Log for heavier text.

WALKING MARCUS, ACTUALLY FULL-BODY
Pant/shoe colors were nearly black against the night bg — only the orange hoodie and skin were visible. Brightened to denim blue + warm brown, added thin dark outlines, added an ear, bumped container to 50×110.

FRIEND CODE OFF PROFILE
Only in Settings → Account now.

QR ENCODES THE INVITE LINK
Scanning offers 'Open in browser' → opens HustleBox → auto-prompts add-friend. If PWA/APK is installed, the OS prefers the installed app via deep link.

SETTINGS EXPLAINER
Note in Settings → Account: 'Sign in to keep your save and friends across devices and browsers. Without an account, your data only lives in this browser — if you clear cache or switch devices, it's gone.'

DESKTOP SCROLL, EXPLICIT
Body/html overflow tightened so long pages always scroll.

No save data wiped.
